create_OpenposeReader: create an OpenposeReader instance to load OpenPose keypoints from a pickle database for a given sequence name
get_data_dict: get a TensorFlow data dictionary with body, hand, face, and foot keypoints from the OpenposeReader
load_openpose_keypoints: load 2D OpenPose body, left hand, right hand, face, and foot keypoints from a .pkl database file
register_tensor: register a human3d dictionary of numpy arrays as TensorFlow tensors using a keypoint ordering mapping
visualize_openpose_keypoints: visualize OpenPose body and foot keypoints on original and cropped images using matplotlib
